UGC NET June 2026 Admit Card – Released - Complete Details

UGC NET June 2026 Admit Card – Released. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. The last date to apply is 29/04/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Apply Online Start Date : 29/04/2026
  • Apply Online Last Date : 24/05/2026 (11:50 PM)
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 23/05/2026 (11:50 PM)

  • Admit Card Date : 17/06/2026
